name: Hugging Face
description: Provides access to Hugging Face Hub information and Gradio AI Applications.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hugging Face to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hugging Face to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://huggingface.co/mcp?login&gradio=none. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hugging Face MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hugging Face provides these MCP tools: hf_whoami, space_search, model_search, model_details, paper_search, dataset_search, dataset_details, hf_doc_search, gr1_flux1_schnell_infer, and gr2_0_abidlabs_easyghiblis_ndition_generate_image.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hugging Face?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hugging Face in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Hugging Face MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hugging Face requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hugging Face is developed by Hugging Face. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
